name: Boomerang Survivor 2
summary:
This is an action game where you defeat enemy characters on the screen with a boomerang.

The main character, Maple, fights against Count Boot, who is trying to conquer Planet Leaf.
This time, the game has been changed to a format where multiple levels are the objective to be achieved, and the variety of stages and enemies has been improved. Control Maple and the boomerang to clear the five levels (21 areas)!
